description: This Java class defines a Fragment for an Android app that displays the first contact stored on the device and provides functionality to add a dummy contact. It demonstrates accessing the Contacts ContentProvider API, handling runtime permissions, and managing contact data through loaders and content resolver operations.

classes.name: ContactsFragment
classes.description: A Fragment that displays contacts and allows adding a dummy contact, demonstrating runtime permission handling and ContentProvider access.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates a new instance of ContactsFragment.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the fragment layout, initializes UI components, and sets button click listeners for loading contacts and adding dummy contacts.

methods.name: loadContact
methods.description: Restarts the loader to query and display the first contact.

methods.name: onCreateLoader
methods.description: Creates a CursorLoader to query the Contacts content provider.

methods.name: onLoadFinished
methods.description: Handles the loaded cursor, displays the first contact's name, and logs contact info.

methods.name: onLoaderReset
methods.description: Resets the UI message when loader is reset.

methods.name: insertDummyContact
methods.description: Inserts a dummy contact with a predefined name into the contacts database.
